scope: Original driver clock-vote experiment from public GPL sources and supervised trial 86; no proprietary codec firmware/library inspection.

facts: vdec_power_on enables VDEC0_VDEC and VDEC1_LARB; it does not separately vote VDEC_ACTIVE.
dec_isr reads VDEC_GCON + 0 and rejects bit 4 set, then requires MISC + 0xa4 bit 16.
CG_VDEC0 mask and VDEC_CG are bit 0 only; enable writes that mask through VDEC_CKEN_SET.
CLK_VDEC_ACTIVE uses the inverted set/clear gate operation at bit 4; prepare/enable therefore sets bit 4.
CLK_VDEC_CKEN is bit 0 and CLK_VDEC_CKEN_ENG is bit 8.

inference: Clearing the inherited ACTIVE gate changed 0x111 to 0x101, but did not produce a done IRQ or correct pixels.
candidate_change: Own bus and engine clocks through CCF; adopt/release inherited ACTIVE through CCF, preserve other owners and reject a remaining ACTIVE bit. No direct clock-register write or completion/stop relaxation.
required_checks: One attributed done event per command and no unexpected events
Safe DMA quiescence, guards and normal unload
Supervised recovery and independent terminal audit

facts: The MT6797 legacy scpsys VDEC domain enables only CLK_VDEC, mapped in the DTS to the topckgen VDEC mux. It does not vote the vdecsys ACTIVE or engine gates.
The board command line contains clk_ignore_unused. Linux clk_disable_unused returns before disabling any unused gate when this argument is set.
The inverted VDEC provider enables ACTIVE by setting bit4 and disables it by clearing bit4.
source_followup_after_trial90.inference: The unchanged first powered snapshot can be consistent with an inherited enabled gate retained by clk_ignore_unused. Source inspection rules out an explicit ACTIVE gate vote in this scpsys power path, but it does not establish the origin of 0x111.
source_followup_after_trial90.next_evidence: The idle framework has no child VDEC gate votes. Qualify explicit ownership initialization through the clock API, preserving the ACTIVE-clear IRQ guard, independent all-CPU IRQ counters, exact pixels, DMA quiescence and recovery. Do not remove global clk_ignore_unused or directly clear clock registers.

hardware_clock_ownership_snapshot.reads: Individual clk_prepare_count and clk_enable_count debugfs files only; no clk_summary, rate or gate-status reads and no MMIO access.
hardware_clock_ownership_snapshot.scope: These cached ownership counters were read after recovery, not concurrently with trial90 powered gate snapshots; they do not establish the hardware word on this boot.

next_evidence: Clock ownership alone did not resolve missing IRQ completion. Investigate the native done-source/interrupt-enable contract using public sources and the preserved failure, retaining exact pixels and DMA-stop requirements.
